fields.description:
## Outcome

Reduce the immediate risk of accidental Sign-Up changes/deletions while preserving the existing guided Screen Flow paths.

## Requirements

* Remove Sign-Up **Delete** access from normal WagerTech personas.
* Keep System Administrator / deliberate admin delete capability for remediation.
* Confirm normal users do not have **Edit Read Only Fields**.
* Review Sign-Up standard page-layout / Dynamic Forms editability so Rep users cannot directly edit protected fields through standard UI paths.
* Preserve the existing guided Screen Flows, including any flows using Salesforce Record Field components that depend on underlying Edit CRUD/FLS.
* Where Ops / Managers legitimately need direct edit access (for example Fraud / Archive sections), capture that as explicit persona requirements rather than opening broad Sign-Up edit access.

## Validation

Test as a Rep user:

* list-view row Edit cannot change protected fields;
* inline edit cannot change protected fields;
* record-page direct edit cannot change protected fields;
* Delete is unavailable;
* existing Log Sign Up / Complete Sign Up / other approved Screen Flow actions still work.

## Related

* WAGR-436
* WAGR-449
* Working plan: https://jumpr.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/JK/pages/268730374/WagerTech+Access+Permission+Model+Working+Plan
